Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000687": Until 2025-09-23, the reporting service depended on the ledger service for the nightly balance export; it no longer depends on the ledger service.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, the peak season.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000948" [decision]: The Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday.  (about: Atlas team, no-deploy Friday)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000823" [decision]: As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000430": INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24.  (about: ledger service, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000941" [decision]: As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000749": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000831": As of 2025-12-01, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
